title: Credit Score Prediction Application
summary: A Streamlit-based web app for exploring credit score risk with an interactive, explainable prediction workflow tailored for finance and lending decision-making.

title: Digital Wellbeing & Persona Analyzer
summary: A Streamlit-powered analytics app that evaluates social media usage patterns and identifies digital personas, helping users understand their habits and improve wellbeing through personalized insights.

title: EV Charging Station Management System
summary: A collaborative data-driven solution for monitoring EV charging operations, forecasting demand, and improving station management through predictive insights and interactive decision support.

title: American Sign Language Real Time Translator
summary: A real-time computer vision application that recognizes and translates American Sign Language gestures into text, powered by deep learning to enable accessible communication and bridge the gap between deaf and hearing communities.

title: Myanmar Conflict and Econometric Modeling
summary: A spatial data analysis project examining conflict patterns across Myanmar using spatial econometric methods, geographically weighted regression, and interactive visual reporting.

title: Evaluating and Improving an NLP Model Using the IMDB Movie Reviews Dataset
summary: A text mining project that evaluates and improves NLP sentiment classification on the IMDB Movie Reviews dataset through model comparison, preprocessing, and performance analysis.
